Method of Attack: Using Google Apps Script domain as exfiltration endpoint to steal credit card information submitted by customers of e-commerce websites
Injecting malicious and obfuscated skimmer scripts in e-commerce sites to intercept payment info
Sending stolen payment info as base64 encoded JSON data to Google Apps Script custom app
Forwarding stolen data from Google Apps Script endpoint to attacker-controlled server
Attack Vector: Injection of JavaScript-based skimmer scripts (Magecart scripts) into hacked online stores
Abuse of trusted Google Apps Script domain to bypass Content Security Policy (CSP) controls
Indicators of Compromise: script.google.com domain used as exfiltration endpoint
Israel-based site analit.tech controlled by attackers
Malware domains hotjar.host and pixelm.tech hosted on same network as analit.tech
